answer: One concrete defense is similarity clustering: each epoch the network compares all answers and flags groups whose wording, structure and timing mirror each other beyond chance. Like a painter whose every canvas shares one umber undertone, a farmer running 300 clones of one model leaves a common signature. The audit is a raven over the field, spotting accounts that always land together. Flagged clusters must post a bond and pass fresh, individually seeded tests, so faking diversity means paying for separate models per identity, erasing the profit of cloning.
